# shopify_shop_metafields (Resource)

The metafield values owned by the shop. There is one per store: Create adopts the shop and writes the listed keys. **Destroy only removes the resource from state**; the values stay in Shopify. Import with `default`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Only the listed keys are managed; other shop metafields keep their values.
# Destroy removes the resource from state and keeps the values in Shopify.
resource "shopify_shop_metafields" "this" {
  metafields = {
    "custom.tagline" = { type = "single_line_text_field", value = "Made in Germany" }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `metafields` (Attributes Map) Metafield values of the shop, keyed `namespace.key` (a namespace of 3-255 and a key of 2-64 letters, digits, hyphens or underscores; the key is split on the first dot). Only the keys listed here are managed: a key removed from the map stops being managed and keeps its value in Shopify. Unset means no metafield is managed. `type` is a [metafield type](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/custom-data/metafields/list-of-data-types) such as `single_line_text_field` or `list.product_reference`; `value` is Shopify's string form: plain text as is, numbers and booleans as strings, list and JSON types as a JSON string (use `jsonencode()`). Shopify rewrites some values (`007` becomes `7`, `TRUE` becomes `true`, JSON is minified); the configured text is kept while it means the same. `value = ""` deletes the metafield, which then reads as `""`. Reference types hold store-specific GIDs, so set them from resource references (`shopify_metaobject.x.id`), not literals. App-owned namespaces (`app--…`) and the SEO metafields `global.title_tag` and `global.description_tag` (use the SEO attributes) are rejected, and import and listing skip them. A metafield with a definition must be written with the definition's type. Writing needs the owner's `write_*` scope (`write_products` for products, not verified alone, see `docs/bootstrapping.md`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metafields))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Shop GID: the shop's metafields have no ID of their own.

<a id="nestedatt--metafields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metafields`

Required:

- `type` (String) Metafield type.
- `value` (String) Value in Shopify's string form; `""` deletes the metafield.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The shop has one set of metafields
terraform import shopify_shop_metafields.this default
```
